items.title: Incyte (INCY) Could Be 6% Undervalued On EU Povofortay Approval
items.summary: Incyte (INCY) is back in focus after the European Commission approved Povofortay for adults with moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa, adding a fresh pillar to its dermatology portfolio beyond its core Jakafi revenue base. Against this backdrop, Incyte’s recent momentum has picked up, with a 7-day share price return of 6.98% at a last close of US$122.63 and a year-to-date share price gain of 20.91%. items.title: Is Incyte (INCY) Priced For Perfection After Its Europe Approval?
items.summary: Incyte has delivered strong share gains over the past few years, and recent progress on its hidradenitis suppurativa treatment adds a fresh layer to the story. The open question is whether the current price can be backed up by the cash flows that the business is expected to generate. Over the last 3 years Incyte has returned 127.0%, which puts a lot of investor expectations on the sustainability of its cash generation.
